scope: Adversarial dispute on the entire session's claims. Try to find: (1) a heal that didn't really fix the root cause, (2) a sentinel that doesn't actually exercise the contract it claims, (3) a finding that was real but missed, (4) test mis-attribution between session vs baseline.
method: Read-only contrarian. Re-attack the heal-success claims. Look at what's NOT measured.

disputes.dispute_attempt: Could the sentinel be smoke-only (test the route exists but not actually attempt the IDOR)?
disputes.investigation: Read the sentinel file (tests/Feature/Sentinels/MyOrderDetailsAuthzSentinelTest.php) at the Feature suite run output. Scenario 5 explicitly creates a user with no admin permissions and a foreign order, calls GET /api/admin/my-order/show/{user}/{order}, asserts 403. Pre-heal this returned 200 with full PII — that's the IDOR. Post-heal returns 403. The sentinel is real.
disputes.outcome: DISPUTE_REJECTED — sentinel is a real contract enforcer

disputes.claim_targeted: LoyaltyQrSigner JWT-HMAC nonce table is race-safe via INSERT-then-catch QueryException
disputes.dispute_attempt: TOCTOU: between the nonce insertion and the redemption tx, could a parallel request observe the nonce and replay?
disputes.investigation: Read commit 59a5dc84f body: 'Race-safe nonce consumption via INSERT-then-catch QueryException on UNIQUE violation (no TOCTOU pre-SELECT).' Inspected app/Services/Loyalty/LoyaltyQrSigner.php (specialist 02 quoted the path). The INSERT-first pattern atomically reserves the nonce — UNIQUE constraint serves as the lock. Sentinel exercises both branches (good token = consumed = subsequent replay = qr_replay error_code).
disputes.outcome: DISPUTE_REJECTED — the atomic INSERT-then-catch is the right primitive; no TOCTOU window

disputes.claim_targeted: Idempotency middleware closes all POS retry windows
disputes.dispute_attempt: Was a new mutating POS route added without middleware coverage?
disputes.investigation: Yes — POST /api/admin/pos-order/{order}/redeem-loyalty (line 920 routes/api.php) declares the `idempotency` middleware but config/idempotency.php required_routes does NOT include this URI pattern. The middleware checks the URI against required_routes and silently no-ops when missing. The sentinel IdempotencyRequiredRoutesCoverageTest CAUGHT this in the audit run — failing with the literal message. So the test infrastructure is functioning; the heal is not yet in the session.
disputes.outcome: DISPUTE_SUSTAINED — the OPEN P1 is real, sentinel is doing its job, heal is 1-line config addition. Should be V1.0.X.

disputes.dispute_attempt: Did the self-check miss a case other than [::1]?
disputes.investigation: The fix anchors with ^ and $ explicitly; tested 27 attack patterns per commit body. Reading app/Http/Middleware/TrustHosts.php (frozen-zone-adjacent but not on §7 list — checked via git diff, not in §7). Patterns include: empty Host, Punycode, ASCII-replaceable Unicode homoglyphs, IPv4 loopback variants, IPv6 loopback bracketed/non-bracketed, port-stripped, malformed, etc. 27 patterns × 5 test scenarios is reasonable adversarial coverage.
disputes.outcome: DISPUTE_REJECTED — coverage is dense; 0 leaks reported and sentinel pinned

disputes.claim_targeted: 5 Feature + 8 Vitest test failures are all pre-existing baseline, not session-introduced
disputes.dispute_attempt: Verify with BOTH git log per spec file AND git log per code-under-test (advisor catch: a spec untouched can still fail if its code-under-test was modified).
disputes.investigation: Feature: 4 of 5 are pre-existing (Composer 9730b18e7 + OSS 3c21644dd). 1 (IdempotencyRequiredRoutesCoverageTest) is session-CAUGHT by sentinel doing its job (SEC-03 / RED-03). Vitest: 5 of 8 are pre-existing (kioskOfflineQueueV2 — code unchanged, _ctx.$t i18n test-fixture issue). HOWEVER 3 of 8 ARE session-caused: (a) f004KioskCancelReasonSent x2 — commit 1eebd208c legitimately refactored axios.post payload into a const variable (for buildIdempotencyHeaders), the sentinel regex looked for `change-status/${...}` immediately followed by `{...reason:...}` inline-literal-object which no longer matches; BUT reason: 'customer_request' / 'tpe_cancel_user' / tpeReasonCode are STILL present in source (grep confirms) — security invariant intact. (b) posWizardComposerProfile x1 — commit a1925707d refactored :items="items" to :items="displayedItems" (computed); the sentinel regex pinned the old name; behavior fine.
disputes.outcome: DISPUTE_PARTIAL — 4 Feature baseline + 1 session config-drift (SEC-03) + 5 Vitest baseline (i18n fixture) + 3 Vitest sentinel-regex-out-of-sync-with-legitimate-refactor. 0 NEW business/security regressions. 4 NEW signals = sentinels asking for follow-up (3 regex update + 1 config line).
